versions.content: Implementation of AutosarVariableRef The reference to rootVariableDataPrototype is not redundant. It is required for identifying the autosarVariable itself in a SenderReceiverInterface or NvDataInterface for the case that the targetDataPrototype is an ApplicationCompositeEle- mentDataPrototype .
